title: build: reject invalid --pull policy values
body:
Unrecognized values passed to --pull were previously ignored and silently fell back to the default "missing" policy. Validate the given value against buildah's PolicyMap and return an error if it is invalid.

Fixes: #30200

comments.body: @arsalanyavari thanks for the PR, but it looks like you have a small lint error.

> @arsalanyavari thanks for the PR, but it looks like you have a small lint error.

Thanks for the heads-up I will Fix it by switching to a switch statement and update the branch.

Thanks for the feedback @danishprakash

I've updated the PR to:

Validate `pullpolicy` in the build API handler (`pkg/api/handlers/compat/images_build.go`) as well, returning a bad request error for unrecognized policies.
Treat empty string values (`--pull=""`) as defaulting to `missing`, preserving compatibility for unset shell variables (`--pull=$POLICY`).
Document the behavior in the man page as suggested by @Honny1, and updated the bats tests accordingly.

I'd really appreciate any suggestions on these.
